shell_commands_self_reported.command: cd <WORKSPACE>/demo/acme-corp/evidence/reports && head -c 2500 change_management_log.md; echo ----; head -c 2000 crowdstrike_endpoint_report.md; echo ----; head -c 3000 github_security_report.md

for f in aws_security_config.json aws_security_hub.json jamf_mdm_compliance.json knowbe4_training_report.json okta_mfa_report.json okta_system_log.json jira_change_tickets.json; do echo "== $f"; grep -o -E '"[A-Za-z_]*(date|time|generated|as_of|period|updated)[A-Za-z_]*": *"[^"]*"' "$f" | sort | uni

grep -o -E '"[A-Za-z_]*(date|time|generated|as_of|period|updated)[A-Za-z_]*": *"[^"]*"' aws_security_config.json aws_security_hub.json jamf_mdm_compliance.json knowbe4_training_report.json okta_mfa_report.json okta_system_log.json jira_change_tickets.json | sort | uniq -c | sort -rn | head -40

grep -o -E '"[A-Za-z_]*(total|count|percent|rate|compliant|enrolled|critical|high|overdue|completion|exempt|mfa)[A-Za-z_]*": *[^,}\n]{1,60}' okta_mfa_report.json aws_security_hub.json jamf_mdm_compliance.json knowbe4_training_report.json | head -60

grep -o -E '"[A-Za-z_]*(total|count|percent|rate|compliant|enrolled|critical|high|overdue|completion|exempt)[A-Za-z_]*": *[0-9.]+' okta_mfa_report.json aws_security_hub.json jamf_mdm_compliance.json knowbe4_training_report.json | head -60
